reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). Avtocod offers a paid B2B REST API (with SDK and Swagger) for VIN/plate vehicle history reports; no listings search API for cars.avtocod.ru.

reason: Avtocod B2B API (https://b2bapi.avtocod.ru/docs/, read 2026-09-25) is documented but (1) reports are generated asynchronously (create a report, then poll it until sources finish), and (2) the Authorization: AR-REST header is base64(user:stamp:age:base64(md5(stamp:age:base64(md5(pass))))) — a base64 of a composed string that the signing modes cannot build. It sells VIN/plate history reports, not listings.
